checks.name: Math filters scan past 40 earlier RW questions before applying the limit
Late geometry and hard-difficulty matches are found
Contradictory or unavailable filters produce empty results
Explicit empty IDs stay empty; selected IDs respect filters
Retired and missing-key questions stay out of new drills
Previously missed history includes scored legacy work and excludes another actor
Repeatedly correct means the actor reached the highest review box
Unseen excludes scored legacy questions and reviewed questions, not someone else’s history
History is applied before limits and sort order is stable
Inactive content cannot enter new drills but explicitly owned legacy reads can load it
Browser roles cannot request keys or another actor’s history
Invalid server filters are rejected, including an unrestricted retired read
Retired reviews cannot hide later usable due items; due history is actor isolated and private
